title: Cha Portal catalog, version 1
description: A list of environments a Cha Portal can launch. The same document is the built-in images/catalog.json and an external catalog an admin loads (docs/image-spec.md, section 6). The portal ignores fields it doesn't know, so no object here forbids extra properties; the schema lists what the portal reads.

version.description: The catalog format. Absent means 1; the portal refuses any other value.

id.description: External catalogs only: the namespace the catalog suggests for itself. The admin chooses the real one when loading it; templates then appear as <catalog>.<template id>.

name.description: External catalogs only: a display name for the catalog.

template.description: One thing a user can launch.

id.description: Unique in the document. Local to it: the portal prefixes an external catalog's ids with the catalog's slug. It becomes a URL path segment, a directory name under the node's data root and part of Docker labels, hence the pattern (the portal itself only rejects empty and repeated ids).

description.description: One or two sentences under the name.

image.description: The image reference to run. In an external catalog it must name a registry (its first path part has a '.' or ':', or is 'localhost'). '{version}' is replaced by the node agent's release.

localImage.description: Built-in catalog only; an external catalog that sets it is refused. A dev build the node runs when it already has it, before pulling 'image'.

class.description: Groups the card. The portal gives 'browser', 'desktop', 'gaming' and 'test' their own icon and lists 'desktop' templates under Desktops; any other value is accepted and gets a generic icon.

icon.description: The app's logo. Built-in catalog: the file name of an SVG in the template's directory under images/ (the portal embeds it). External catalog: an https:// URL, or a path relative to the catalog's URL; SVG only, at most 256 KiB, with a viewBox. Absent: the card shows a generic icon for the class.

security.description: The confinement profile of the app container. 'standard': Docker's default seccomp profile. 'browser': also allows creating namespaces, for Chrome's and Firefox's sandboxes. 'steam': 'browser' plus the cha-sandbox AppArmor profile and a high open-files limit. In an external catalog, 'browser' and 'steam' stay unavailable until an admin approves them.

shmMb.description: Size of /dev/shm in MiB. Docker's default is 64; browsers need 512 to 1024.

persistent.description: The default for whether users keep their home (/home/cha) between launches. Users and admins can change it. Default false.

fixedSize.description: The app's display has a fixed size (CHA_WIDTH x CHA_HEIGHT): the page never asks for a resize and the browser letterboxes the picture. Default false.

shared.description: A directory shared by all users of this app, mounted when its access isn't 'none'. These are defaults; an admin can change the access.

access.description: 'none': not mounted. 'read': mounted read-only. 'write': mounted read-write.

perUser.description: Paths inside the shared directory (relative, no leading slash) that each user keeps their own copy of, mounted over it from the user's home. Default empty.

gamepad.description: The virtual controller the app gets unless the user picks another. Default 'xbox360'.

fps.description: The frame rate the app gets unless the user picks another. Default 60. Any other number is ignored and 60 is used.

needsGpu.description: The app needs real 3D and never runs on the CPU device. Default false.
